comment: The Mantel the moment Chapter 1 is over: every lead pulled, the case closed, and `ending_seen` still false -- so arriving at the hub plays the First File card once and then leaves the board reading `mantel.board_closed` rather than the lull string. Exists so the chapter's LAST screen can be reviewed and photographed without playing the whole chapter (law 1): `godot --path game -- --tour --tour-out <dir> --scene scenario:chapter_closed`. Same profile as case_board_end, which shoots the finished BOARD; this one shoots the ending.
